description: 🔑 Requires the same API key that started the scan. Stops a scan that is still running (pending/crawling/scanning) and returns the quota unit it cost, if the scan was started within the last hour. Use it when check-compliance was called by mistake or the wrong URL was scanned. A scan that already completed or failed cannot be cancelled and nothing is refunded. Scans started with a different API key are reported as not found. Free — does not use quota itself.

scanId.description: The scan ID returned by check-compliance

name: cancel-scan

error.description: Set when nothing was cancelled (unknown/foreign scan, already finished, Trigger.dev error)

refunded.description: true if one quota unit was returned

status.description: "cancelled" on success; the actual status if the scan had already finished

title: Cancel Running Scan
